title: A Pretrainer's Guide to Training Data: Measuring the Effects of Data Age, Domain Coverage, Quality, & Toxicity
measurement_description: The paper evaluated the models' propensity to generate biased or toxic text in response to prompts related to religion, as part of a broader 'Representational Bias' benchmark.
models_tested: LM-XL (1.5B parameter model based on t5.1.1-XL architecture)
LM-SMALL (20M parameter model based on t5.1.1-small architecture)
findings: The paper used prompts related to religion to evaluate toxic text generation. However, it does not provide disaggregated results for this specific category. General findings indicate that filtering toxic content from pretraining data creates a trade-off: it reduces the generation of toxic text but also harms the model's general performance and its ability to identify toxicity.
